implementationScope: package-only progressive JFIF 4:2:0 incremental session with semantic-unit marker streaming, exact-MCU transactional transport and cadence-aware output lifetime

cases.mechanismPressure: every byte boundary plus every completed-scan preview; preview cadence must retain one reusable RGB backing
final-only cadence must cross all scans without allocating the 995328-byte RGB backing; finish-only render is phase-separated from MCU rollback
every restart marker is split at FF|Dn while no RGB backing is retained before finish

requiredInvariants: All v4 marker-streaming and 414-byte transport invariants remain unchanged: whole encoded marker extent is distinct from semantic-unit residency, DQT/DHT stream by table unit, metadata admission is header-early, JFIF/Adobe authority is explicit and MCU suspension is transactional.

Preview cadence is a resource input. every-completed-scan allocates one RGB backing at the first completed scan and reuses it for later previews; final-only allocates no RGB backing at SOF2, at EOI or between calls.

For final-only sessions, pre-finish retainedBetweenCalls is transport plus progressive state only. transferredOutput still publishes the admitted final RGB byte count and codecOwnedRGB8 authority before the backing is materialized.

For final-only sessions, operationPeak is max(initialRetained + state, transport + state + rollbackScratch, transport + state + finalRGB). MCU rollback scratch and final RGB render are mutually exclusive phases and must not be summed.

For every-completed-scan sessions, retainedBetweenCalls includes one RGB backing after the first preview and operationPeak continues to include that backing together with MCU rollback because later entropy work and the reusable preview output coexist.
A final-only current preview request before finish is unsupported rather than forcing hidden RGB materialization; finish renders exactly once and returns the byte-identical packed RGB value.

Every report requires final RGB bytes to equal the complete-input independent decoder byte-for-byte, completed scan numbers to be contiguous, accepted/reclaimed input to close exactly and terminal finish to publish zero codec-owned state.
This profile does not qualify public DecodedImage color representation, non-JFIF semantics, embedded ICC, other sampling modes, physical RSS, allocator headers or perceptual reconstruction quality.
